reputation_adjustment.rule: Shrink a branch rating toward the active-network mean. The prior strength is equivalent to 100 reviews and reduces the influence of sparse samples.

purpose: Define the evidence, peer-comparison, confidence, and labelling contract for a public-proxy branch-health screen before any branch score is calculated.

peer_comparison.rule: A branch may be percentile-compared only with active branches in the same source-backed format archetype. When fewer than three peers exist, retain the feature but disclose network-wide comparison only.

public_reputation.rule: Use only a permitted, attributable source and shrink sparse rating samples before peer normalization.

competitor_pressure.rule: Use as a limited two-brand proximity signal only; never interpret zero as no local competition.

own_network_overlap.rule: Use only as geometric proximity; it is not observed cannibalization.

coverage_uniqueness.rule: Not available in v1; do not substitute nearest distance or pairwise overlap for this feature.

minimum_scoring_requirements: peer group or explicit NETWORK_COMPARISON_ONLY fallback
input snapshot and model version provenance

missingness.rule: Do not impute missing public reputation or format archetype. Coverage uniqueness is unavailable in v1 and must be disclosed as an omitted factor. Withhold a branch-health score until the remaining minimum scoring requirements are met.

labelling.rule: Labels prioritize human strategic review; they do not authorize an operating decision.

source_reliability.basis: The values were manually transcribed and user-validated from direct Google Maps branch listings, but were not collected through a reproducible paid API feed.

feature_completeness.basis: Three of four permitted model factors are available; coverage uniqueness is omitted.

competitor_scope.basis: Two high-relevance named chains are verified, but the wider independent and chain competitor market is not exhaustive.

confidence.rule: A high proxy score cannot offset weak evidence confidence.
